name: TEST RANGE: a course of action
about: Orders for the command-line runner (cli/run.gd --coa=...) on the TEST RANGE scenario. Times are seconds from the start. LANCER closes on the inspector it holds a track on (planned on that track, not the truth); EXCALIBUR tries to jam it but is refused, because nobody has identified the track as an enemy (the rules of engagement); EXCALIBUR then makes a small burn; LANCER's buoy order is refused (the range has no buoy class); an order to a Red ship is refused. The runner reports each order with whether it was carried out, and why not. The 0.003 km/s burn is a design value for the example.
